jobs.title: Solutions Consultant - UK
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software, and we’re looking for a Solutions Consultant to help Rillet enter its next phase of growth.

We’ve grown quickly and are expanding our GTM team to accelerate that trajectory. You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, and company leadership to help prospective customers evaluate Rillet as their next ERP.

As an early member of Rillet’s UK GTM team, you’ll be uniquely positioned to shape how we sell, test new approaches, and help build the foundation for Rillet’s go-to-market motion in the UK.

What You'll Do

Remove technical and accounting objections. Play a key role throughout the sales cycle by helping prospective customers evaluate Rillet from both a technical and accounting perspective. You’ll understand their business requirements, accounting processes, and existing technology stack; explain how Rillet fits into their environment; and show how it can improve the way their finance team operates.
Deliver tailored product demonstrations. Configure sandbox environments and tailor demonstrations around each prospect’s specific workflows and use cases. You’ll run high-impact demos, answer detailed questions in real time, and adapt your approach based on the customer’s priorities. You’ll act as a trusted consultant throughout the evaluation process.
Become a product and domain expert. Develop a deep understanding of Rillet, accounting workflows, and the broader technology ecosystem used by modern finance teams. You’ll be able to answer the vast majority of product, accounting, and technical questions directly without needing to rely on the Product team.
Execute with urgency. Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to Sales, Product, Engineering, and company leadership in near real time. Experiment with different demo approaches, contribute to thoughtful customer follow-ups, and help accelerate opportunities through the sales process.
Represent Rillet. Be a trusted face of the company, bringing high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to every prospect interaction. You’ll engage with sophisticated finance and accounting leaders and continue to deepen your expertise in the domain.

Who We're Looking For

Strong professional experience in accounting, with exposure to areas such as revenue recognition, financial close, reconciliations, and multi-entity consolidation.
Experience supporting customer evaluations, implementations, solutions consulting, or customer-facing work involving accounting or financial software.
Strong understanding of the systems and technology used by modern finance and accounting teams.
Familiarity with IFRS and/or UK GAAP and the ability to speak credibly with senior finance and accounting stakeholders.
Excellent communicator who can make complex accounting and technical concepts easy to understand and communicate in a clear, conversational way.
Comfortable moving between accounting, product, and technical conversations with different stakeholders.
Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail.
Proactive, highly responsive, and comfortable taking ownership in an early-stage environment.
ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent accounting qualification, or experience beginning your career in audit or accounting advisory, is a plus.

Life at Rillet

Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.
Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.
Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.
Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant (DACH)
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization
.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire
customer journey.

We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi
— so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

We're looking for a Solution Consultant to join our presales team covering EMEA. Fluent German is required for this position.

This is a customer-facing, consultative role. You'll run discovery conversations, deliver tailored product demonstrations, and translate complex platform capabilities into clear business outcomes. You won't be writing code all day — but you'll need to understand how data flows, integrations work, and how marketing teams actually operate.

We also expect you to be curious about AI and actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work — whether that's preparing for demos, researching prospects, building content, or finding smarter ways to get things done. We're not looking for an AI engineer, but for someone who naturally reaches for AI as a productivity multiplier and stays current with how it's reshaping martech and presales.

This is not a senior or principal-level hire. We're looking for someone with solid foundations and strong potential — someone who's sharp, curious, and ready to grow into a trusted advisor for enterprise customers.

The base salary range for this position is €70,000-€87,000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above.

What You'll Do

Run discovery with prospects — ask the right questions to understand business challenges, current tech stack, and what success looks like for them
Deliver product demonstrations — not generic feature tours, but tailored sessions that connect our platform to the customer's specific use cases
Build and present solution concepts — translate customer requirements into clear, compelling narratives around our technology
Support the sales cycle end-to-end — from initial qualification through technical validation to close, working in lockstep with your AE
Handle technical questions and objections — bridge the gap between what the customer's marketing and IT teams need to hear
Prepare and deliver workshop-style sessions — for mid-market and enterprise evaluation processes, often with multiple stakeholders in the room
Leverage AI tools proactively — use AI assistants, copilots, and automation to accelerate research, demo prep, content creation, and internal workflows
Collaborate internally — work with Product, Customer Success, and Professional Services to ensure what we propose is what we can deliver
Contribute to presales assets — demo environments, use case libraries, and reusable content that makes the whole team better

What You Bring

Fluent English (primary working language) and strong German — you can present, write, and hold business conversations in both
Based in the UK, comfortable covering EMEA with occasional travel for key customer meetings, workshops, and team events
Experience working with enterprise or mid-market customers — you understand how buying decisions are made in larger organisations
Confidence presenting to groups — whether it's a 1:1 with a Head of CRM or a room of 15 stakeholders, you hold the room
Strong communication and discovery skills — you listen well, ask structured questions, and explain technical concepts in business language
Curiosity and structured thinking — you enjoy understanding how things work and can break down complex topics logically
Active use of AI tools — you already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools in your work and you're genuinely interested in how AI is changing the way we sell, consult, and build solutions
2–5 years of professional experience in a relevant field — this could be presales, solution consulting, technical consulting, digital/CRM agency work, martech consulting, implementation consulting, technical account management, or a similar customer-facing role

We explicitly welcome candidates from adjacent backgrounds. If you've spent the last few years configuring marketing platforms, running client workshops at a digital agency, or consulting on CX strategy — and you're ready to move into a presales role — we want to hear from you.

Nice to Have

Experience in SaaS, martech, or the broader digital marketing ecosystem
Familiarity with CDPs, CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, or personalisation engines
Hands-on experience delivering demos or running customer workshops
Understanding of ecommerce platforms and digital marketing operations
Basic technical literacy — APIs, data integrations, webhooks, SQL, or similar (you don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be afraid of a JSON payload)
Experience using AI for content generation, prospect research, or workflow automation beyond basic prompting
Additional European languages (French, Spanish, Dutch, etc.) — useful but not required
Experience working directly with sales teams and navigating commercial conversations

What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

You independently run discovery and demo cycles for mid-market and enterprise opportunities across EMEA
AEs actively want you on their deals because you make the conversation better
Customers leave your sessions with a clear understanding of how the platform fits their world — not just what buttons it has
You've built a working knowledge of our platform, key use cases, and competitive landscape
You use AI tools as a natural part of your workflow — and you've probably shown the team a few tricks they hadn't thought of
You contribute ideas and content that improve how the presales team operates
You're developing toward owning more complex, strategic engagements

Why This Role

Real growth path. This is a P3 role with a clear trajectory. We invest in developing Solution Consultants — not just deploying them.
Work that matters commercially. You're not a demo jockey. You directly influence whether enterprise deals move forward and how they're shaped.
Strong product. It's significantly easier to sell and consult on a platform that actually works. Ours does.
AI-forward team. We actively encourage using AI tools to work smarter. You won't have to justify why you're using ChatGPT — you'll have to explain why you're not.
Collaborative team. Presales here is respected, not an afterthought. You'll work closely with experienced AEs, product leaders, and fellow SCs who share what they know.
EMEA scope from the UK. Broad exposure to different markets, industries, and buying cultures — with German as your edge for one of Europe's most important enterprise markets.

Flexibility.
Remote-friendly setup, with travel for key customer engagements and team events — not a road warrior schedule.

The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above.

Base Salary Range

€70.000—€87.000 EUR

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*
We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Mobility & Regulatory Analyst

Transportation Law Practice

Windels Marx Lane & Mittendorf, LLP (Windels Marx), a leading New York City-based, multi-state law firm is seeking a mobility and regulatory analyst to join its well-established and expanding transportation practice.  This niche practice is supported by a full-service legal platform, with a core emphasis on transportation regulation, licensing, compliance, administrative & procurement law, general counselling, emerging transportation technologies, and industry trend analysis. The firm’s transportation practice represents a wide variety of domestic and international clientele, and delivers comprehensive solutions by regularly interfacing with related legal disciplines, including: labor/employment law; transportation finance/lending; tax and corporate governance; litigation; contracts; data/privacy/intellectual property; merger/acquisition/due diligence; foreclosure and bankruptcy.

The firm was founded in the 1800s, employs more than 140 lawyers and 60 non-lawyer professionals, and is frequently cited and commended by legal industry benchmarking surveys, including The New York Law Journal’s “NYLJ 100: Largest Private Law Offices,” Best Lawyers, Best Law Firms, the Forbes Legal Black Book, and SuperLawyers. The firm’s transportation practice is a diverse, dynamic team that includes former commissioners, judges, prosecutors, regulatory analysts, urban planners, engineers, and economists devoted to living and breathing transportation law and policy on a 24/7 basis.

The firm’s transportation practice represents a broad range of mobility companies, with an emphasis on innovative business models and transportation technology start-ups. Represented modes, clients, and services include:

·      Transportation Network Companies (TNCs) consisting of ride-hail smartphone apps;
·         Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) software platforms;
·         Micro-mobility companies (e-scooters, e-mopeds & bike share);
·     Financial institutions, private equity & hedge funds investing in mobility companies and taxicab medallions;
·         Electric vehicle manufacturers, partners and stakeholders (and other alternative fueled vehicles);
·         Connected & Autonomous Vehicle manufacturers, partners and stakeholders;
·         Transportation technology start-ups (mobility, software platforms, insurance, and telematics);

·         Freight, logistics, and package delivery companies;

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Monument is the operating system for self-storage companies — the platform operators run their entire business on. Payments, GAAP-compliant accounting, physical access control, customer operations, delinquency, inventory, REIT-level revenue management, and portfolio-wide oversight all run through one system. This is a rare opportunity to reinvent a $30 billion market from the ground up.

About the Role

As Monument’s Client Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end success of a portfolio of enterprise self-storage clients — from complex, multi-threaded onboarding through long-term value realization.

At its core, this is a project management role. You’ll run multiple implementations at once with strict adherence to timelines and process, and with the attention to detail and organization enterprise clients expect. You’ll also operate as a consultant: configuring the platform yourself and advising clients on the workflows that move the metrics they care about most — above all, Net Operating Income (NOI).

Your clients stay yours after go-live. You’ll deliver ROI-focused quarterly business reviews that drive product adoption, champion the voice of the customer inside Monument, and build with AI every day so more of your time goes to clients.

Above all, you are client-focused and outcome-driven: success is measured by what your clients achieve. It’s a fast-paced role where you’ll wear many hats — subject matter expert, project manager, configuration specialist, trusted advisor — with one goal: maximizing each client’s ROI on Monument.

Monument CSMs do not carry an upsell quota or earn commission on cross-sells. You're expected to educate clients on paid offerings when they genuinely serve the client, but because your compensation is never tied to those recommendations, you remain a trusted, unconflicted advisor first.

Your Responsibilities

Complex Onboarding & Implementation Management
: Lead end-to-end onboarding for enterprise clients, running multiple concurrent workstreams (data migration, integrations, configuration, and training) across internal teams and client stakeholders. Build and maintain detailed project plans, enforce strict adherence to timelines and process, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and drive clients to their go-live dates to reach fast time to value. Operate as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor throughout: adhere to internal SLAs, keep the open-items and issues log current, maintain the project task list, lead data inspection to ensure an accurate data migration, and provide hands-on go-live support.
Value Realization & Product Training
: Serve as a training and business consultant, guiding clients to adoption of features and best practices that optimize Net Operating Income (e.g., dynamic pricing, revenue management, delinquency automation, revenue capture, targeted campaigns). Continuously assess adoption gaps and build tailored account plans to close them.
Customer Advocacy & Voice of the Customer (VOC)
: Act as the primary internal advocate for your assigned accounts. Run a disciplined Voice of the Customer practice that captures, structures, and prioritizes client feedback and feature requests, and be the internal champion for customer enhancements, carrying them through Product, Support, and leadership so the client's voice shapes what Monument builds next. Articulate the value and business impact of each requested enhancement, track its status through delivery, and close the loop with clients when their features ship.
High-ROI Quarterly Business Reviews
: Own the QBR cadence for your portfolio. Continuously evaluate what each account needs most, then deliver high-ROI QBRs (data-driven narratives on adoption, performance, and business outcomes) that measurably increase product adoption and align clients on goals and priorities for the quarter ahead. Anchor each review in a client-specific account plan built to optimize their NOI.
ROI Measurement & Reporting
: Establish baseline data collection during onboarding, then build and present clear, credible ROI analyses that quantify the business impact of each client's Monument investment over time.
NPS, References & Case Studies
